summary: Comprehensive testing of OPT Points Tutorial/Onboarding feature completed. All 10 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all 5 modal steps, navigation, and Settings page integration. Fixed missing 'complete_tutorial' action in database.

backend_api_tests: POST /api/auth/onboarding/complete - marks tutorial complete and awards 200 OPT (first time)
POST /api/auth/onboarding/complete - returns 0 points on repeat completion
POST /api/auth/onboarding/reset - resets tutorial status for replay
Reset and replay flow works correctly
complete_tutorial action exists in points engine with 200 base points and 'once' cooldown
frontend_ui_tests: Onboarding modal appears automatically on dashboard for users with show_tutorial=true

Step 2: How to Earn Points with earning methods list
Step 3: Streak Bonuses showing 7/30/90/365 day milestones
Step 5: You're All Set with +200 OPT reward message
Progress dots (5 dots) visible for navigation
Next button navigates through all steps
Back button returns to previous step
Get Started button completes tutorial and closes modal
Settings page has Help & Tutorials section
Replay Tutorial button with data-testid='replay-tutorial-btn' present
Replay Tutorial button reopens modal from Settings

critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints properly implemented with authentication
Points awarded only on first completion (cooldown='once' enforced)
Tutorial status tracked in user document (tutorial_completed, tutorial_completed_at)
